external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app to borrow, renew and reserve books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who use the circulation page to change loan and account records.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual staff and branch cannot be identified from the history.

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone through which members request loan renewals and reservations.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Kiosk
processes.description: A branch self-service kiosk that scans a member's library card and books and sends loans and returns to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
processes.notes: The kiosks are Dev's team's area; their other communications are not known.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API that is the service interface for loan operations, checks loan rules, and reads and writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Lending service note says 'The lending API is internal-only.' Interview transcript says 'The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.' These are conflicting exposure claims, so exposure is unknown. Priya said: 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, member contact details, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The two former databases were merged into one loans database; the old reservations database is gone.

data_flows.name: borrow renew reserve
data_flows.description: A member initiates borrowing, renewing or reserving a book through the library app and lending service.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Member, book and loan or reservation request

data_flows.name: renew reserve
data_flows.description: The library app sends member and book requests to the lending API for renewals and reservations.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: The app's authentication mechanism is uncertain: Priya said, 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'
data_flows.data_description: Member and book identifiers, loan renewal or reservation request

data_flows.name: send loan return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends each scanned loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: Member card, book and loan or return record

data_flows.name: change loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared desk login. The password is on a card taped under the desk, and the history cannot identify the individual or branch.

data_flows.name: read write records
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes member, loan and reservation records in the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations and borrowing histories

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states that these personal details and borrowing histories live in the loans database.
